vBRIEFInfo.description: XumuxClient, XumuxServer, Channel abstraction (ReadableStream/WritableStream), public API surface

narratives.Description: Implement the public-facing library API. src/channel.ts: a Channel class wrapping { readable: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, writable: WritableStream<Uint8Array> } with channel state tracking (opening, open, closing, closed). src/connection.ts: shared XumuxPeer base class wiring codec, control handler, and transport together; dispatches inbound frames to the correct channel's ReadableStream controller. XumuxClient extends XumuxPeer and initiates the HELLO handshake. XumuxServer extends XumuxPeer and awaits HELLO, responds WELCOME, assigns channel IDs. src/index.ts: re-exports XumuxClient, XumuxServer, Channel, and all types. All types are JSDoc-documented and zero 'any' in public surface.
narratives.Traces: FR-7, FR-8, FR-18, NFR-1, NFR-2, NFR-7
